zh: 内置组件的视觉统一：标题区不再带英文眉标与编号，右上角的统计随界面语言显示；番茄钟与天气回到单色基调，强调色只留给进度、当前项与主按钮，饱和色只留给图片、全息与磁吸卡，这几张在深色下各有一套从看板底色推出来的明度；翻转卡用令牌的正反两面；数字、表盘、时钟、翻转卡、表格、待办空态与余额按高度档位放大读数；图表补上面积填充、刻度值与末端数据点；天气预报每天带温度，「今天」按预报所在地的日期判定，缓存跨零点后自动丢掉过去的日子；题头右侧改成一块缩小的看板图案；键值卡与 Markdown 卡的示例收短，滚动区在行首吸附，Markdown 卡的最小高度抬到 18rem 以放下默认内容；余额卡没有登录时显示「登录后显示余额」，只有调用出错才用错误色；月历、时钟、改动、表盘与热力图补上默认盒子与最小盒子。
en: Built-in widget visuals are unified. Title areas no longer carry English eyebrows or numbers, and the top-right counts follow the interface language. Pomodoro and weather return to the monochrome base with the accent reserved for progress, the current item and the primary button; saturated color stays on the image, holographic and magnetic cards, each with a dark-scheme value derived from the board background, while the flip card uses the token pair on its two faces. Stat, gauge, clock, flip card, table, the todo empty state and balance scale their readouts by height tier. The chart gains an area fill, tick values and an end dot. Each weather forecast day shows its temperature, and "today" follows the forecast location's date, dropping past days from a cached response. The board hero art becomes a miniature board. The key-value and Markdown samples are shorter, scroll areas snap to row starts and the Markdown card's minimum height is raised to 18rem so its default content fits. The balance card shows "Sign in to see your balance" when no account is signed in and uses the error color only when the call fails. Calendar, clock, diff, gauge and heatmap now declare a default box and a minimum box.
